items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Clark Terry, Claude Perry, Dizzy Gillespie, John Faddis

ctx.x: Yes, he played a chorus, I played a chorus on trumpet, Clark Terry, Claude Perry, Dizzy Gillespie, John Faddis, and ... is that 6? Dizzy Gillespie, Claude Perry, Clark Terry, Doc Cheatham, Faddis, Carter -- Faddis, Carter -- who was the other one? There was another one -- there were 6 of us. Harry Edison.
